editorial.blurb: This unpretentious gem near Granville station serves up authentically flavorful Thai food with generous portions and a server who truly listens to your needs.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask your server for recommendations if you have allergies—they'll guide you thoughtfully, and don't skip the Thai iced tea (order extra to go).

topDishes.note: Reviewers' absolute favorite—perfectly balanced flavor and spice, pairs beautifully with Thai fried rice
